acceptanceCriteria: Clickable proof review binds diff hunks, explicit obligations, original evidence, supplied versus observed tests, and remaining unknowns; invalid or absent inputs never become a proof of readiness.
An explicit bounded test-attack run exposes surviving changed-condition mutants and failures/partial execution without altering default prove behavior or automatically running at agent Stop.

A host-neutral task handoff retains exact candidate, scope, caller decisions and review feedback, plus next actions, and refuses drift before returning resumable context; actual host limits remain explicit.

A change breakage map joins declared participating repositories, changed declarations, caller/test/flow/documentation witnesses and unresolved edges with immutable inputs; missing relationships remain unknown.

Agent instruction diagnostics explain the exact qualified host load sets, shadowing/truncation/conflicts and suspicious characters, citing actual rule sources and exposing unsupported host/version cases.

A runnable disposable proof tour exercises orientation, change, missing witness, repair, independent review and portable offline verification, retaining actual pass/failure evidence and cleaning up its owned processes.

Every slice has stable owning spec requirements, relevant focused checks, actual CLI/use evidence and independent review. The final combined candidate is bound with CEM/OCM and dogfood receipts, published as a verified draft PR; native tickets stay open until required integration and completion writes succeed.
